comparison.objective: Move a flammable cardboard box off a heater into a marked safe zone while leaving a metal-pot decoy untouched.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires the resting box at the safe-zone center within 3 cm; partial credit requires it at least 9 cm from the heater center.
comparison.reason: This is hazard-aware object relocation without precision tooling, fracture, impact control, or fragment recovery.
